title: Run report
description: Result of one perf-mode run. Written by the reporter in onEnd; read by the CLI (thresholds --from, report) and rendered to HTML (11). Everything the HTML report shows must be here (01-REQ-22).

configDir.description: Absolute directory of the Playwright config file; base for relative paths (01-REQ-21).

suite.description: What the report is about (02-REQ-42, 11-REQ-49): the name of the package.json in configDir (source package), else the Playwright config path relative to the repository root (source config). Left out when neither is known.

config.description: Effective package config after merging with defaults (00, 4.4), in JSON form (02-REQ-17, 03).

normalization.description: Normalization fingerprint of this run (07-REQ-21); copied to generated.normalization of derived thresholds files and compared with it (09-REQ-04).

stepNormalization.description: Step normalization fingerprint (06-REQ-25); null when measure.steps is disabled. Copied to generated.normalization of derived step thresholds files.

ci.description: CI metadata read from well-known environment variables (02-REQ-28); null outside CI or when no known provider is detected and CI is unset.
True when the CI environment variable is set.

cpuModel.description: os.cpus()[0].model, trimmed; empty string when unknown.

passes.description: Passes of the run (D-39, 02-REQ-37): the test command runs once per pass and the first pass merges them.

completed.description: Passes whose data are in the report, including the first one.

failed.description: Numbers of passes without data (RUN_PASS_FAILED), ascending.

shards.description: Shards merged into this report (17-REQ-17): null for a run without shards, an object after PW_PERF_MODE=merge.

missing.description: Shard numbers without a shard file (MERGE_SHARD_MISSING), ascending.

list.description: The merged shards by index, ascending.

samples.description: Request and step samples of the shard.

buildUrl.description: ci.buildUrl of the shard job, or null.

runConditions.description: Effective run conditions read from FullConfig in onBegin (ADR-0006).

name.description: Project name; empty string for the default project.

role.description: measured: repeated and measured; dependency / teardown: referenced by another project, not repeated (D-04).

requestOnly.description: true for a measured project that recorded request calls and no browser sample (02-REQ-42); left out otherwise.

overriddenSettings.description: Playwright settings changed by withPerf(), e.g. 'use.video', 'retries' (01-REQ-37).

tests.description: Functional test results, independent of the evaluation (P-08). Counters follow TestCase.outcome().

evaluation.description: Run-level evaluation summary. Per-key details live in endpoints and steps (02-REQ-15).

thresholdFiles.description: Thresholds files the reporter tried to load.

toolErrors.description: Problems that make the run result incomplete or untrustworthy; non-empty means exit code 3 (09-REQ-23). Collector diagnostics go to warnings.

origins.description: Origins of measured requests and their labels (07-REQ-03), sorted by origin. Shows which backend the run measured.

label.description: Label used in keys; empty string for the base origin.

endpoints.description: Aggregates of backend endpoints by normalized key.

steps.description: Aggregates of test.step durations by step key (06); empty when measure.steps is disabled.

testBreakdown.description: Per-test costs and the waterfall of the slowest test runs (08-REQ-37, 08-REQ-38); null only in a report migrated from version 1.

tests.description: Tests with at least one api request, most expensive first; at most 500 (08-REQ-37).

omitted.description: Tests with requests beyond the first 500.

waterfalls.description: Slowest test runs, one per test; at most 5 (08-REQ-38).

fromFile.description: Keys evaluated with thresholds from the file.

notEvaluated.description: Keys not evaluated, for any reason.

tooFewSamples.description: Keys not evaluated because no rule had enough samples (part of notEvaluated).

fileEntriesNotEvaluated.description: Keys with an entry in the thresholds file that were seen but not evaluated: too few samples (part of tooFewSamples, 09-REQ-17).

medianOnly.description: Evaluated keys for which median was the only time rule run (too few samples for the percentile rule).

unseenThresholdEntries.description: Entries in the thresholds file whose key did not occur in the run.

violations.description: Keys with at least one failed check.

blockingViolations.description: Keys with at least one blocking failed check.

path.description: Path relative to configDir, with forward slashes.

status.description: loaded; missing (not an error, 00 4.5); invalid (tool error, exit code 3).

generated.description: Copy of the file's 'generated' block; null when missing, invalid or hand-written.

unseenKeys.description: Keys present in the file but not seen in the run, sorted.

aggregate.description: Statistics of all samples of one key (08).

successCount.description: Successful samples with browser timing; only these enter time statistics (08-REQ-02).

errorCount.description: Samples counted as errors: endpoints with a status in checks.errors.statuses (08-REQ-05).

fromFailedTests.description: Samples that came from tests that did not pass (D-05).

testCount.description: Distinct tests in which the key occurred; repetitions of the same test count once (08-REQ-06).

statuses.description: Sample count per status. Endpoints: HTTP code, FAILED (failed without response), ABORTED (cancelled by the browser), PENDING (in flight at test end). The labels ok, error and unfinished are reserved for step outcomes (06) (08-REQ-05).

stats.description: Time statistics of successful samples; null when successCount is 0.

ttfb.description: TTFB of successful samples that have it. Null when no sample has TTFB.

otherP50.description: p50 of max(0, duration - ttfb) over the samples of p50 (08-REQ-35); null only in a report migrated from version 1.

slowest.description: Up to 3 slowest successful samples, slowest first.

topTests.description: Up to 5 tests with the most samples of this key (08-REQ-33), most samples first.

sampleCount.description: Samples of this key from all repetitions of the test.

samples.description: Retained successful durations, used to derive thresholds without rerunning tests (thresholds --from).

durations.description: Sorted ascending. At most advanced.maxSamplesPerKey values (08).

sampled.description: True when successCount exceeded the limit and durations is a seeded uniform sample (P-06).

histogram.description: Histogram of the retained durations on a fixed log scale (08-REQ-34); bin i is [edges[i], edges[i+1]). counts has edges.length - 1 entries that sum to samples.durations.length (checked by the parser). Null when stats is null, or in a report migrated from version 1.

edges.description: Bin edges in ms, strictly ascending (checked by the parser); constants of the scale, not rounded to 0.1 ms.

cold.description: Cold samples: the first measure.coldSamples timed samples of the key in each pass (08-REQ-41, 08-REQ-43). Null when measure.coldSamples is 0 or the key has no timed samples.

nonSuccessCount.description: Endpoints: samples with an HTTP status outside measure.successStatuses, whatever checks.errors.statuses says (08-REQ-46). Null for steps.

failedTimings.description: Endpoints: durations of the non-success samples per status, up to 5 statuses with the most samples (08-REQ-47); not part of the time statistics. Empty for steps.

hints.description: Hints that explain the result of the key, in rule priority order (11-REQ-34); at most 3.

stepAggregate.description: Statistics of all samples of one step key (06-REQ-28): the aggregate fields plus location and stepErrorsFromFailedTests. ttfb is null; time sources count node samples.

successCount.description: Successful samples with browser timing; only these enter time statistics (08-REQ-02).

errorCount.description: Samples counted as errors: endpoints with a status in checks.errors.statuses (08-REQ-05).

fromFailedTests.description: Samples that came from tests that did not pass (D-05).

testCount.description: Distinct tests in which the key occurred; repetitions of the same test count once (08-REQ-06).

statuses.description: Sample count per status. Endpoints: HTTP code, FAILED (failed without response), ABORTED (cancelled by the browser), PENDING (in flight at test end). The labels ok, error and unfinished are reserved for step outcomes (06) (08-REQ-05).

stats.description: Time statistics of successful samples; null when successCount is 0.

ttfb.description: TTFB of successful samples that have it. Null when no sample has TTFB.

otherP50.description: p50 of max(0, duration - ttfb) over the samples of p50 (08-REQ-35); null only in a report migrated from version 1.

slowest.description: Up to 3 slowest successful samples, slowest first.

topTests.description: Up to 5 tests with the most samples of this key (08-REQ-33), most samples first.

sampleCount.description: Samples of this key from all repetitions of the test.

samples.description: Retained successful durations, used to derive thresholds without rerunning tests (thresholds --from).

durations.description: Sorted ascending. At most advanced.maxSamplesPerKey values (08).

sampled.description: True when successCount exceeded the limit and durations is a seeded uniform sample (P-06).

histogram.description: Histogram of the retained durations on a fixed log scale (08-REQ-34); bin i is [edges[i], edges[i+1]). counts has edges.length - 1 entries that sum to samples.durations.length (checked by the parser). Null when stats is null, or in a report migrated from version 1.

edges.description: Bin edges in ms, strictly ascending (checked by the parser); constants of the scale, not rounded to 0.1 ms.

cold.description: Cold samples: the first measure.coldSamples timed samples of the key in each pass (08-REQ-41, 08-REQ-43). Null when measure.coldSamples is 0 or the key has no timed samples.

nonSuccessCount.description: Endpoints: samples with an HTTP status outside measure.successStatuses, whatever checks.errors.statuses says (08-REQ-46). Null for steps.

failedTimings.description: Endpoints: durations of the non-success samples per status, up to 5 statuses with the most samples (08-REQ-47); not part of the time statistics. Empty for steps.

hints.description: Hints that explain the result of the key, in rule priority order (11-REQ-34); at most 3.

location.description: Smallest (file, line) location among the key's samples, file relative to configDir with '/'; null when no sample has one (06-REQ-28).

stepErrorsFromFailedTests.description: error and unfinished samples from failed tests; not counted in errorCount or the errors rule (06-REQ-32).

hint.description: A rule-based one-sentence explanation of the key result; the HTML report builds the text from code and params (11-REQ-34).

params.description: Numbers and names for the text template; the fields per code are listed in 11-REQ-34.

testCost.description: Cost of one test for the backend over all its runs: api requests only (08-REQ-37).

title.description: Titles from the outermost describe to the test, joined with ' › '.

file.description: Relative to configDir, with forward slashes.

executions.description: Test results with a samples attachment, also without requests.

requestCount.description: All request samples of the test from all runs.

totalMs.description: Sum of the durations of time-usable requests from all runs; parallel requests count in full.

maxRequestMs.description: Longest time-usable request, or null when there is none.

keyCount.description: Distinct endpoint keys called by the test.

topKeys.description: Up to 3 keys with the largest totalMs, then count, then key.

count.description: All samples of the key in the test.

violatedKeys.description: Keys of the test with evaluation result fail, sorted, at most 10; length is min(10, violatedKeyCount) (checked by the parser).

violatedKeyCount.description: Keys of the test with evaluation result fail.

waterfall.description: One run of a test as a timeline (08-REQ-38); requests.length + omitted = requestCount (checked by the parser).

totalMs.description: Sum of the durations of time-usable requests of this run.

spanMs.description: Largest offset + duration of all requests of this run.

requests.description: First 200 requests by offset, then by position in the samples attachment.

omitted.description: Requests of this run beyond the first 200.

waterfallRequest.description: Start of a request relative to the start of the test run (TestResult.startTime).

offset.description: Whole ms from the start of the test run; 0 for requests that started earlier.

duration.description: Duration of a time-usable request, otherwise null.

percentiles.description: Always p50, p90, p95, p99, plus the evaluated percentile when it is another one (08).

count.description: Number of cold samples (at most measure.coldSamples per pass and shard).

excluded.description: True when the cold samples are left out of the time statistics and successCount (08-REQ-42).

reason.description: too-few-samples: without the cold samples the key would have fewer than checks.time.median.minSamples warm samples, so the cold samples stay in the statistics.

durations.description: Durations of the cold samples in input order, at most the first 5.

warmP50.description: p50 of the warm samples; when every sample is cold (excluded false), the p50 of all timed samples (08-REQ-43).

ratio.description: max / warmP50, 2 decimal places; null when warmP50 is null or 0.

test.description: Test of the first cold sample.

workload.description: Samples of the key in the thresholds run (base, the source block of the entry) and in this run (now) (09-REQ-40).

perPassRatio.description: (now.count / now.passes) / (base.count / base.passes), 2 decimal places; null when base.count is 0.

shifted.description: perPassRatio is at least thresholds.workloadShift.factor or at most its inverse (09-REQ-41).

share.description: count of the key / count of all keys of the kind, 4 decimal places.

url.description: Raw URL. Present only when raw URLs are enabled in config (D-11, 02-REQ-16).

title.description: Titles from the outermost describe to the test, joined with ' › '.

file.description: Relative to configDir, with forward slashes.

reason.description: Why the key was not evaluated (P-10): too-few-samples (no enabled rule had enough samples), no-rules (all applicable rules disabled), thresholds-error (the thresholds file of this kind is invalid, 09-REQ-12). Null otherwise.

thresholdSource.description: Where the applicable limits come from.

limits.description: Limits applied to this key after filling missing ones from the rule limits in the config (02-REQ-21, 09-REQ-06). t, minApdex and maxWilson are null when the apdex and wilson rules do not apply (default thresholds, or a file entry without t); with t set, a missing minApdex or maxWilson comes from checks.slowShare.apdex.limit / wilson.limit.

maxNonSuccessRate.description: Limit of the nonSuccess rule (09-REQ-38): from the entry, or checks.nonSuccess.limit.api for endpoint keys without one; null when the rule does not apply.

checks.description: Checks that were run (which ones depends on the sample count, 09). Empty when not evaluated.

muted.description: Muting from the thresholds file entry (gate: warn, 09-REQ-26), or null when the entry is not muted or the key has no entry.

expired.description: True when the run started after 'until': muting no longer applies.

workload.description: Workload of the key compared with the thresholds run (09-REQ-40); null without an entry with a source block.

rule.description: Rule name (09, 5.2). apdex, wilson, errors and nonSuccess compare a bound of a 95% interval (09-REQ-09).

n.description: Samples the rule used: retained timing samples for time, apdex and wilson rules, all samples of the key for errors.

actual.description: Value compared with the limit: ms for median/percentile/p99; for apdex the upper bound, for wilson and errors the lower bound of the 95% interval.

observed.description: Point estimate behind a bound: Apdex score, share of samples slower than T, error rate. Null for time rules.

hardLimitExceeded.description: Time rules only (median, percentile, p99): the value exceeds limit x gate.hardLimitFactor (09-REQ-11). Always false for apdex, wilson and errors.

blocking.description: This failed check fails the run under the gate policy (D-16, D-17). False for passed checks.

usage.description: Part of the limit used, 4 decimal places (11-REQ-30): actual / limit, for apdex (1 - actual) / (1 - limit); at most 1 for a passed check. Null when the limit leaves no headroom (limit 0, apdex limit 1) and the value is not at it, or in a report migrated from version 1.

provider.description: github, gitlab, jenkins, azure, or other (CI set, provider unknown).

commit.description: Commit SHA, or null when unknown.

branch.description: Branch name, or null when unknown.

buildUrl.description: URL of the CI job or build, or null when unknown.
